detailed_descriptions_html.en:
If you enjoy "Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising" and wish to support our team on the journey of game development, you can purchase this Supporter Pack. Thank you very much!

This Supporter Pack includes the following:

  • Unlock the Max Level Boon – continuously obtain precious treasure chests over real time and pick your desired equipment!

  • Offline rewards are increased by an additional 30%.

  • Offline rewards can be accumulated for up to 48 hours.
